note: Each TRACI score cell is independently multiplied by a uniform random factor in [0.50, 1.50] (i.e. ±50%). Non-numeric and zero values are left unchanged. TRACI scores in this file are synthetic and must not be used as a substitute for licensed Ecoinvent values. Every other column — including cost_per_unit and cost_source — is copied through unchanged and carries its real, publicly sourced value.
